sources.name: IndianaMap / Indiana DNR Lake Bathymetry Contours
sources.attribution: Indiana Department of Natural Resources, Division of Fish and Wildlife
sources.notes: Polyline bathymetric contours; shoreline = elevation 0; contour values are feet below surface. Surveyed with Biosonics DTX echosounder. Contour intervals vary by lake (commonly 5 or 10 ft). Updated ~2019 in FeatureServer; some newer PDF surveys not yet in vector layer.
